about_pullquote: Quality work, fair pricing, and respect for your home—that's how we've built our reputation.
about_para_1: Watsbury Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Southampton for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that good decoration needn't break the bank, we've grown from a one-person operation to a trusted team known for honest pricing and meticulous attention to detail. We've completed over 1,000 projects, from fresh beige feature walls to full exterior repaints.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, we turn up on time, and we leave your home spotless. We don't use high-pressure sales tactics or hidden charges. Whether you need a quick refresh or a complete home makeover, you'll get a straightforward quote and a decorator who cares about doing the job right.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Watsbury

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs done—living room, hall, and kitchen. Mark turned up when he said he would, got on quietly, and the finish is brilliant. Paid what was quoted, no nasty surprises. Already booked him in for the bedrooms next month.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.text: My daughter's bedroom was in a right state. Watsbury stripped the old paper, made good the walls, hung new wallpaper, and painted the woodwork. They cleaned up after themselves properly. She loves it. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Needed the exterior doing urgently before we sold. Got a quote back within two days, work started the following week, and they finished on schedule. The team were professional and respectful. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Robert P.
